🔥 vigil-tui | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Monitoring and analyzing real-time hardware power consumption and performance metrics directly within the terminal.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time wattage, thermals, clock speeds, and electricity cost monitoring for CPU, GPU, and RAM • Per-core utilization and frequency display • Process-level power estimation and ranking • Power and clock history charts (Braille area chart) • Throttle detection and alerts
📖 Summary: Vigil-tui is a real-time terminal dashboard for monitoring hardware power consumption, thermals, and performance metrics. It provides detailed insights into CPU, GPU, and RAM usage, along with process-level power estimation and cost analysis, all within a single command-line interface.
